job.name: D0StandaloneSyntheticMoreTagsDroy64V2_@SUBMISSION_TAG@
job.command:
set NEVENTS = @NEVENTS@ set NJOBS = @NJOBS@ set BASE_SEED = @BASE_SEED@ set EVENT_ID_BASE = @EVENT_ID_BASE@ set SUBMISSION_TAG = "@SUBMISSION_TAG@"
# Two disjoint random streams per job. JOBINDEX makes every seed unique. @ PYTHIA_SEED = ${BASE_SEED} + 2 * ${JOBINDEX} @ MORETAGS_SEED = ${BASE_SEED} + 2 * ${JOBINDEX} + 1
# Non-overlapping event-ID blocks across all jobs in this submission. @ FIRST_EVT_ID = ${EVENT_ID_BASE} + ${JOBINDEX} * ${NEVENTS} @ LAST_EVT_ID = ${FIRST_EVT_ID} + ${NEVENTS} - 1
if ( ${PYTHIA_SEED} <= 0 || ${PYTHIA_SEED} > 900000000 ) then echo "ERROR: invalid PYTHIA seed: ${PYTHIA_SEED}" exit 84 endif
if ( ${MORETAGS_SEED} <= 0 || ${MORETAGS_SEED} > 900000000 ) then echo "ERROR: invalid MoreTags seed: ${MORETAGS_SEED}" exit 85 endif
if ( ${FIRST_EVT_ID} <= 0 || ${LAST_EVT_ID} > 2147483647 ) then echo "ERROR: invalid EvtId range: ${FIRST_EVT_ID}--${LAST_EVT_ID}" exit 86 endif
set SCRATCH = `pwd` set PROJECT = /gpfs01/star/pwg/lomicond/Ondrej/Jets/PythiaD0JetGeant/D0EmbeddingClean set OLD_D0WF = /gpfs/mnt/gpfs01/star/pwg/lomicond/Ondrej/Jets/PythiaD0JetGeant/D0EmbeddingClean
set DROY_STAR = /gpfs01/star/pwg/droy1/STAR-Workspace/LocalSTAR/SL16d_embed_64b set DROY_ROOT4STAR = ${DROY_STAR}/.sl73_x8664_gcc485/BIN/root4star set DROY_DEDX = ${DROY_STAR}/.sl73_x8664_gcc485/LIB/libStdEdxY2Maker.so set PICO_LIB = local_SL22c_pico_lib/libStPicoDstMaker.so
if ( ! -x "${DROY_ROOT4STAR}" ) then echo "ERROR: Droy root4star is unavailable: ${DROY_ROOT4STAR}" exit 80 endif
if ( ! -r "${DROY_DEDX}" ) then echo "ERROR: Droy libStdEdxY2Maker.so is unavailable: ${DROY_DEDX}" exit 81 endif
set DEDX_MD5 = `md5sum "${DROY_DEDX}" | awk '{print $1}'`
if ( "${DEDX_MD5}" != "eaed165ff1ed2b5e556b08d82f5fe139" ) then echo "ERROR: unexpected Droy libStdEdxY2Maker.so MD5: ${DEDX_MD5}" exit 82 endif
# Stage 6 must use the isolated SL22c PicoDstMaker build. Check it # before starting the expensive simulation and reconstruction stages. if ( ! -s "${PICO_LIB}" ) then echo "ERROR: isolated SL22c PicoDstMaker library is missing from the sandbox:" echo " ${SCRATCH}/${PICO_LIB}" exit 83 endif
foreach FILE (`grep -rl "${OLD_D0WF}" scripts src templates`) sed -i "s|${OLD_D0WF}|${SCRATCH}|g" ${FILE} end
set RUNLOG = "${PROJECT}/log/D0StandaloneSyntheticMoreTagsDroy64V2_${SUBMISSION_TAG}_${NEVENTS}evts_seed${PYTHIA_SEED}_${JOBID}_${JOBINDEX}.log"
echo "SUBMISSION_TAG=${SUBMISSION_TAG}" >! "${RUNLOG}" echo "JOBINDEX=${JOBINDEX}/${NJOBS}" >> "${RUNLOG}" echo "NEVENTS=${NEVENTS}" >> "${RUNLOG}" echo "PYTHIA_SEED=${PYTHIA_SEED}" >> "${RUNLOG}" echo "MORETAGS_SEED=${MORETAGS_SEED}" >> "${RUNLOG}" echo "FIRST_EVT_ID=${FIRST_EVT_ID}" >> "${RUNLOG}" echo "LAST_EVT_ID=${LAST_EVT_ID}" >> "${RUNLOG}"
tcsh scripts/run_standalone_production_synthetic_moretags_droy64_v2.csh \ ${NEVENTS} 1 0 ${PYTHIA_SEED} ${MORETAGS_SEED} ${FIRST_EVT_ID} \ >>&! "${RUNLOG}" set RUN_STATUS = $status
set STANDWORK = work/jobs/st_physics_15130045_raw_${FIRST_EVT_ID}_${NEVENTS}evts_seed${PYTHIA_SEED}_standalone_synthetic_moretags_droy64_v2 set MUDST = "${STANDWORK}/mixer/st_physics_15130045_raw_1000011.MuDst.root" set PICO = "${STANDWORK}/pico/st_physics_15130045_raw_1000011.picoDst.root"
if ( ${RUN_STATUS} != 0 ) then # Keep a successfully reconstructed MuDst even when stage 6 fails. if ( -s "${MUDST}" ) then set CHECKPOINT_DIR = "${PROJECT}/production/synthetic_moretags/checkpoints" set CHECKPOINT_MUDST = "${CHECKPOINT_DIR}/D0StandaloneSyntheticMoreTagsDroy64V2_${SUBMISSION_TAG}_${NEVENTS}evts_seed${PYTHIA_SEED}_${JOBID}_${JOBINDEX}.MuDst.root"
mkdir -p "${CHECKPOINT_DIR}" cp "${MUDST}" "${CHECKPOINT_MUDST}" set CHECKPOINT_STATUS = $status
if ( ${CHECKPOINT_STATUS} == 0 && -s "${CHECKPOINT_MUDST}" ) then echo "CHECKPOINT_MUDST=${CHECKPOINT_MUDST}" >> "${RUNLOG}" else echo "WARNING: failed to save MuDst checkpoint: ${CHECKPOINT_MUDST}" >> "${RUNLOG}" endif endif
exit ${RUN_STATUS} endif
set PRODUCTION_DIR = "${PROJECT}/production/synthetic_moretags" set OUTPUT_STEM = "D0StandaloneSyntheticMoreTagsDroy64V2_${SUBMISSION_TAG}_${NEVENTS}evts_seed${PYTHIA_SEED}_${JOBID}_${JOBINDEX}" set FINALMUDST = "${PRODUCTION_DIR}/${OUTPUT_STEM}.MuDst.root" set FINALPICO = "${PRODUCTION_DIR}/${OUTPUT_STEM}.picoDst.root" set FINALMETA = "${PRODUCTION_DIR}/${OUTPUT_STEM}.metadata.txt"
mkdir -p "${PRODUCTION_DIR}"
if ( ! -s "${MUDST}" ) then echo "ERROR: final MuDst is missing: ${MUDST}" >> "${RUNLOG}" exit 89 endif
if ( ! -s "${PICO}" ) then echo "ERROR: final PicoDst is missing: ${PICO}" >> "${RUNLOG}" exit 90 endif
cp "${MUDST}" "${FINALMUDST}" set COPY_MUDST_STATUS = $status
if ( ${COPY_MUDST_STATUS} != 0 ) then echo "ERROR: failed to copy final MuDst to ${FINALMUDST}" >> "${RUNLOG}" exit ${COPY_MUDST_STATUS} endif
cp "${PICO}" "${FINALPICO}" set COPY_PICO_STATUS = $status
if ( ${COPY_PICO_STATUS} != 0 ) then echo "ERROR: failed to copy final PicoDst to ${FINALPICO}" >> "${RUNLOG}" exit ${COPY_PICO_STATUS} endif
echo "SUBMISSION_TAG=${SUBMISSION_TAG}" >! "${FINALMETA}" echo "JOBID=${JOBID}" >> "${FINALMETA}" echo "JOBINDEX=${JOBINDEX}" >> "${FINALMETA}" echo "NEVENTS=${NEVENTS}" >> "${FINALMETA}" echo "PYTHIA_SEED=${PYTHIA_SEED}" >> "${FINALMETA}" echo "MORETAGS_SEED=${MORETAGS_SEED}" >> "${FINALMETA}" echo "FIRST_EVT_ID=${FIRST_EVT_ID}" >> "${FINALMETA}" echo "LAST_EVT_ID=${LAST_EVT_ID}" >> "${FINALMETA}" echo "MUDST=${FINALMUDST}" >> "${FINALMETA}" echo "PICO=${FINALPICO}" >> "${FINALMETA}"
exit 0
